fields.recommendation: The capstone is ungradable as posed: no learner-reachable tool evaluates the capstone inputs. Either add free-input modes to the three panels (display fix listed) and relax the panelCapstoneGuard policy to 'defaults may not land on an answer', or state z at every station in the prompt so the closed forms the lessons teach become hand-calc.
fields.evidence: Needs z from Sutton + Dranchuk-Abou-Kassem at the capstone's own pressure and temperature. The lessons never write the Sutton formula or the DAK coefficients (beginner m02 l01 only tabulates z at gravity 0.65), and DAK is an iterative solve. All three panels are select-only over published rows and teaching wells (no NumField in DropletExplorer/ProfileExplorer/RemedyExplorer; gasWellLab.js deliberately carries no capstone well, panelCapstoneGuard.test.js). The Suite Gas Well Performance Studio is never named, builds its own traverse from a well model, prints no z or density, and prints rates as integers and velocities to 1 dp (/opt/petrolord-studio/workspaces/dev1/projects/petrolord-suite/src/components/gaswell/fields.jsx:28 fmt default 0 digits; LoadingPanel.jsx:71/78).
